title: Bledsoe's craft bigger inside than outside

tellings.quote: Chris Bless tells the story 30t on the outside and he looks inside and it's the size of a football game.

plain: A craft seen in North Carolina is said to have been about 30 feet across on the outside, but when the man looked inside, it seemed as big as a football field. The story belongs to Chris Bledsoe, a man known for repeated UFO experiences, and it is passed on by the UFO researcher Grant Cameron, who repeats what Bledsoe tells. If true, it would mean the craft holds more space inside than its outer size allows.
